Subject: Interview scheduling for Staff SWE role — quick confirm & accommodations

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for applying and for speaking with us last week. We’d like to schedule the onsite/virtual hybrid loop for the Staff Software Engineer role on Thursday, June 24th. Proposed schedule (all times PT):

- 10:30–11:30 AM — System design with Diego (onsite panel + remote)
- 11:45–12:30 PM — Deep dive/coding (pairing) — remote for candidate, onsite for interviewer
- 1:00–1:30 PM — Lunch + break
- 1:45–2:15 PM — Cross-functional conversation with PM
- 2:30–3:00 PM — Hiring manager sync and wrap

We can host you in our SF office if you’d like to come onsite for the panel; otherwise you can join fully remote. Please confirm:
- which option you prefer (onsite at Redwood SF or fully remote)
- whether you need any accessibility accommodations (ASL interpreter, extra time for coding, quiet room, escort to the office, etc.)

I’ve attached the panel run-of-show and a calendar hold (will update once you confirm). If you prefer remote-only, I’ll send a Zoom link and instructions for the pairing exercise.

Attachments: panel_run_of_show.pdf (agenda + interviewer list), resume_jane_doe.pdf

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com>

Date: 2027-06-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling for Staff SWE role — quick confirm & accommodations

Thanks, Olga —

I appreciate the schedule. I can do June 24th and would prefer to come onsite to the SF office. A few accommodation requests:

- I use ASL as my primary language and will need an ASL interpreter for the interview loop.
- For the coding session, I typically request an extra 30 minutes and permission to type rather than whiteboard.
- I’ll also need an escort from the lobby to the interview room and a quiet room for any breaks.

I’ve attached a completed accommodation form for your records. My travel is flexible; I can arrive the morning of the 24th.

Attachments: accommodation_form_filled.pdf

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
Jane
